scope: Implementation and reference gap audit; no complete app or desktop parity claim
common_limits: Current suite views are independently implemented; they are not Apple executable applications.

21 dedicated Cutefish desktop launch identities: 20 native window applications plus Apps as a shell modal overlay. Registry shape is source/test verified; native-window preview checks and actual Linux startup remain separate runtime gates.
Existing static REA evidence for 25 app/shell targets is reused rather than counted as new reverse engineering.
Resource records and window-load smoke checks do not prove feature completeness.
No cloud account, private message library, or real calling service was accessed in this audit.
